exports.name: Deploy orchestrator
exports.description: One entry point: preflight, OS, Ceph, Kubernetes, add-ons, verify. Stops at the first failure and logs every phase.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site — {{value.clusterName}} ({{value.env}})
# One entry point, six phases, stop at the first failure.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LOG_DIR="$HERE/logs"
export DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-0}"
FROM=""; VERIFY_ONLY=0; ASSUME_YES=0

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ./deploy.sh [--dry-run] [--phase NN] [--verify] [--yes]

  --dry-run    Print every action, change nothing.
  --phase NN   Start at a phase: 00 10 20 30 40 50.
  --verify     Run only the acceptance checks (phase 50).
  --yes        Do not ask for confirmation.
EOF
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --phase) FROM="$2"; shift ;;
    --verify) VERIFY_ONLY=1 ;;
    --yes|-y) ASSUME_YES=1 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown option: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
  shift
done

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
STAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

phase() {
  local num="$1" title="$2" script="$3"
  if [ -n "$FROM" ] && [ "$num" \< "$FROM" ]; then return 0; fi
  if [ ! -f "$HERE/$script" ]; then
    echo "SKIP  $num $title — $script is not part of this plan"
    return 0
  fi
  echo "==>   $num $title"
  set +e
  bash "$HERE/$script" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/$num-$STAMP.log"
  local rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  set -e
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "FAIL  $num $title (exit $rc) — log: $LOG_DIR/$num-$STAMP.log" >&2
    exit "$rc"
  fi
  echo "OK    $num $title"
}

if [ "$ASSUME_YES" -eq 0 ] && [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ] && [ "$VERIFY_ONLY" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "This configures every node in nodes.tsv and deploys {{value.clusterName}}."
  printf 'Type the cluster name to continue: '
  read -r answer
  [ "$answer" = "{{value.clusterName}}" ] || { echo "aborted"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "$VERIFY_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  phase 50 verify 50-verify.sh
  exit $?
fi

phase 00 preflight       00-preflight.sh
phase 10 "OS baseline"   10-os-baseline.sh
phase 20 "Ceph"          20-ceph.sh
phase 30 "Kubernetes"    30-kubespray.sh
phase 40 "add-ons"       40-addons.sh
phase 50 verify          50-verify.sh

echo
echo "Done. Logs: $LOG_DIR"

exports.name: Preflight checks
exports.description: Read-only: registry, SSH, clock, disk and DNS on every node, before anything changes.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Read-only checks on the admin host. Changes nothing, anywhere.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
NODES="$HERE/nodes.tsv"
FAIL=0; WARN=0

ok()   { printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$*"; }
bad()  { printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$*"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }
warn() { printf 'WARN  %s\n' "$*"; WARN=$((WARN + 1)); }

for t in ssh curl awk; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || bad "missing tool: $t"
done
[ -f "$NODES" ] || { bad "nodes.tsv is missing"; exit 1; }

# Registry first: without it, nothing else matters.
if curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null "https://{{value.registryAddr}}/v2/"; then
  ok "registry https://{{value.registryAddr}}/v2/"
else
  bad "registry unreachable: https://{{value.registryAddr}}/v2/"
fi

while IFS=$'\t' read -r role name ip; do
  case "$role" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac

  if ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -p {{value.sshPort}} "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip" true 2>/dev/null; then
    ok "$name ssh"
  else
    bad "$name ssh unreachable ($ip:{{value.sshPort}})"
    continue
  fi

  if ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -p {{value.sshPort}} "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip" \
      "chronyc tracking >/dev/null 2>&1 && chronyc tracking | awk '/System time/ {print \$4}'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^[0-9.]*$'; then
    ok "$name chrony"
  else
    warn "$name chrony not reporting (install it in phase 10)"
  fi

  avail=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -p {{value.sshPort}} "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip" \
    "df -BG --output=avail / | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9'" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "${avail:-0}" -ge 20 ]; then
    ok "$name disk ${avail}G free"
  else
    bad "$name disk under 20G free (${avail:-0}G)"
  fi

  if ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -p {{value.sshPort}} "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip" \
      "getent hosts {{value.registryHost}} >/dev/null" 2>/dev/null; then
    ok "$name resolves {{value.registryHost}}"
  else
    bad "$name cannot resolve {{value.registryHost}}"
  fi
done < "$NODES"

echo
echo "preflight: $FAIL failure(s), $WARN warning(s)"
[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]

exports.name: OS baseline orchestrator
exports.description: Copies the node payload to every host and runs it. Idempotent.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Copies 10-os-node.sh to every node and runs it. Idempotent.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
NODES="$HERE/nodes.tsv"
PAYLOAD="$HERE/10-os-node.sh"
[ -f "$PAYLOAD" ] || { echo "missing $PAYLOAD" >&2; exit 1; }

while IFS=$'\t' read -r role name ip; do
  case "$role" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac
  echo "--- $name ($role, $ip)"
  scp -P {{value.sshPort}} -o BatchMode=yes "$PAYLOAD" "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip:/tmp/10-os-node.sh"
  ssh -p {{value.sshPort}} -o BatchMode=yes "{{value.adminUser}}@$ip" \
    "sudo bash /tmp/10-os-node.sh && rm -f /tmp/10-os-node.sh"
done < "$NODES"

echo "OS baseline applied. Reboot nodes whose kernel arguments changed before phase 30."

exports.name: OS baseline payload
exports.description: Runs on a node: time, DNS, access, kernel, limits, SELinux, firewall, audit, updates.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Runs ON a node as root. Idempotent; safe to re-run.
set -euo pipefail

TZ_NAME="{{value.osTimezone}}"
LOCALE="{{value.osLocale}}"
NTP_LIST="{{value.ntpServers}}"
DNS_LIST="{{value.dnsServers}}"
DNS_SEARCH="{{value.dnsSearchDomain}}"
ADMIN_USER="{{value.adminUser}}"
SSH_PORT="{{value.sshPort}}"
PASSWORD_AUTH="{{value.sshPasswordAuth}}"
NOPASSWD="{{value.sudoNopasswd}}"
SWAP_OFF="{{value.swapDisabled}}"
THP="{{value.transparentHugePages}}"
FD_MAX="{{value.fileDescriptorsMax}}"
SELINUX="{{value.selinuxMode}}"
FIREWALL="{{value.firewallBackend}}"
AUDIT_DAYS="{{value.auditRetentionDays}}"
AUTO_UPDATES="{{value.unattendedSecurityUpdates}}"
KERNEL_ARGS="{{value.kernelArgs}}"

timedatectl set-timezone "$TZ_NAME"
localectl set-locale LANG="$LOCALE" 2>/dev/null || true

# --- time -----------------------------------------------------------------
install -d /etc/chrony.d
: > /etc/chrony.d/00-platform.conf
IFS=',' read -ra SRV <<< "$NTP_LIST"
for s in "${SRV[@]}"; do echo "server ${s// /} iburst" >> /etc/chrony.d/00-platform.conf; done
systemctl enable --now chronyd 2>/dev/null || systemctl enable --now chrony 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl restart chronyd 2>/dev/null || true

# --- name resolution ------------------------------------------------------
IFS=',' read -ra DNS <<< "$DNS_LIST"
CON="$(nmcli -t -f NAME connection show --active | head -1 || true)"
if [ -n "$CON" ]; then
  nmcli con mod "$CON" ipv4.dns "$(IFS=' '; echo "${DNS[*]}")" ipv4.dns-search "$DNS_SEARCH"
  nmcli con up "$CON" || true
else
  printf 'nameserver %s\n' "${DNS[@]}" > /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "search $DNS_SEARCH" >> /etc/resolv.conf
fi

# --- access ---------------------------------------------------------------
id "$ADMIN_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$ADMIN_USER"
if getent group wheel >/dev/null; then usermod -aG wheel "$ADMIN_USER"; else usermod -aG sudo "$ADMIN_USER"; fi

if [ "$NOPASSWD" = "true" ]; then
  echo "$ADMIN_USER ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/90-automation
  chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-automation
  visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/90-automation >/dev/null
else
  rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/90-automation
fi

install -d -m 0755 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
{
  echo "Port $SSH_PORT"
  # Keep 22 open during the change; close it once the new port is proven reachable.
  [ "$SSH_PORT" = "22" ] || echo "Port 22"
  echo "PasswordAuthentication $([ "$PASSWORD_AUTH" = "true" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "PermitRootLogin prohibit-password"
  echo "MaxAuthTries 4"
} > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-platform.conf
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || true

# --- kernel and memory ----------------------------------------------------
if [ "$SWAP_OFF" = "true" ]; then
  swapoff -a || true
  sed -ri '/\sswap\s/s/^#?/#/' /etc/fstab
fi

cat > /etc/sysctl.d/90-platform.conf <<EOF
vm.max_map_count = 262144
fs.file-max = $FD_MAX
kernel.pid_max = 4194304
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables = 1
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables = 1
EOF
sysctl --system >/dev/null

cat > /etc/modules-load.d/90-platform.conf <<EOF
overlay
br_netfilter
nf_conntrack
rbd
EOF
modprobe overlay || true
modprobe br_netfilter || true
modprobe rbd || true

cat > /etc/security/limits.d/90-platform.conf <<EOF
*    soft nofile $FD_MAX
*    hard nofile $FD_MAX
root soft nofile $FD_MAX
root hard nofile $FD_MAX
EOF

if [ -w /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled ]; then
  echo "$THP" > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled || true
fi

if [ -n "$KERNEL_ARGS" ]; then
  if command -v grubby >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="$KERNEL_ARGS"
  else
    sed -i "s/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=\"\(.*\)\"/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=\"\1 $KERNEL_ARGS\"/" /etc/default/grub
    update-grub
  fi
  echo "REBOOT REQUIRED: kernel arguments changed"
fi

# --- security -------------------------------------------------------------
if command -v getenforce >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  setenforce 0 2>/dev/null || true
  sed -i "s/^SELINUX=.*/SELINUX=$SELINUX/" /etc/selinux/config
fi

if [ "$FIREWALL" = "firewalld" ] && command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl enable --now firewalld
  firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port="$SSH_PORT/tcp" >/dev/null
  firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null
elif [ "$FIREWALL" = "nftables" ] && command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport "$SSH_PORT" accept 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ -f /etc/audit/auditd.conf ]; then
  sed -i "s/^num_logs = .*/num_logs = $((AUDIT_DAYS > 5 ? 5 : AUDIT_DAYS))/" /etc/audit/auditd.conf || true
  systemctl restart auditd 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ "$AUTO_UPDATES" = "true" ]; then
  if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y dnf-automatic >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sed -i 's/^upgrade_type = .*/upgrade_type = security/' /etc/dnf/automatic.conf 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl enable --now dnf-automatic.timer 2>/dev/null || true
  elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dpkg -l unattended-upgrades >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get install -y unattended-upgrades
    systemctl enable --now unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi

echo "baseline applied: $(hostname)"

exports.name: Ceph phase
exports.description: Bootstraps Ceph on the first MON, adds every role host with its label, applies the role spec, waits for HEALTH_OK.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Runs on the admin host. Bootstraps Ceph on the first MON, then adds every role host.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
MON1="{{cephMonIp}}"
SSH_OPTS="-o BatchMode=yes -p {{value.sshPort}}"
BOOT="$HERE/ceph-bootstrap.sh"
SPEC="$HERE/cluster-spec.yaml"
[ -f "$BOOT" ] || { echo "missing $BOOT" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SPEC" ] || { echo "missing $SPEC" >&2; exit 1; }

if [ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "would scp ceph-bootstrap.sh + cluster-spec.yaml to $MON1 and run cephadm bootstrap"
  exit 0
fi

scp $SSH_OPTS "$BOOT" "root@$MON1:/root/ceph-bootstrap.sh"
ssh $SSH_OPTS "root@$MON1" "bash /root/ceph-bootstrap.sh"

# Copy the admin keyring to every other role host so cephadm shell works there too.
for h in {{cephOtherIps}}; do
  ssh $SSH_OPTS "root@$MON1" "ssh -o BatchMode=yes root@$h 'mkdir -p /etc/ceph' && scp -o BatchMode=yes /etc/ceph/ceph.conf /etc/ceph/ceph.client.admin.keyring root@$h:/etc/ceph/" \
    || echo "WARN: keyring copy to $h failed; add it manually"
done

# Add hosts with their role label. Explicit hosts, not labels alone: a typo must fail here.
while read -r cmd; do
  [ -n "$cmd" ] || continue
  ssh $SSH_OPTS "root@$MON1" "cephadm shell -- $cmd" || echo "WARN: $cmd"
done <<'CMDS'
{{cephHostAddCmds}}
CMDS

scp $SSH_OPTS "$SPEC" "root@$MON1:/root/cluster-spec.yaml"
ssh $SSH_OPTS "root@$MON1" "cephadm shell -- ceph orch apply -i /root/cluster-spec.yaml"

echo "waiting for HEALTH_OK (up to 20 minutes)"
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  health=$(ssh $SSH_OPTS "root@$MON1" "cephadm shell -- ceph health" 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
  echo "  $health"
  case "$health" in HEALTH_OK*) exit 0 ;; esac
  sleep 30
done
echo "Ceph did not reach HEALTH_OK. Inspect: cephadm shell -- ceph -s" >&2
exit 1

exports.name: Kubernetes phase
exports.description: Runs the pinned Kubespray release from its own virtualenv, then waits for every node to be Ready.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Runs on the admin host, against the inventory generated with this plan.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
RUN="$HERE/run-kubespray.sh"
[ -f "$RUN" ] || { echo "missing $RUN" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HERE/hosts.ini" ] || { echo "missing hosts.ini" >&2; exit 1; }

if [ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "would run: bash $RUN"
  exit 0
fi

bash "$RUN"

KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/opt/kubespray/inventory/{{value.clusterName}}-{{value.env}}/artifacts/admin.conf}"
export KUBECONFIG
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready node --all --timeout=15m
kubectl get nodes -o wide

exports.name: Add-ons phase
exports.description: Installs exactly the add-ons whose values files were generated. A missing chart is reported, never pulled from the internet.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Installs only the add-ons whose values files were generated with this plan.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
CHARTS="$HERE/charts"
KUBECTL=(kubectl)

run() {
  if [ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then echo "dry-run: $*"; return 0; fi
  "$@"
}

helm_install() {
  local name="$1" ns="$2" chart="$3"; shift 3
  if [ ! -f "$CHARTS/$chart" ]; then
    echo "SKIP $name: $CHARTS/$chart not present (mirror the chart first)"
    return 0
  fi
  run helm upgrade --install "$name" "$CHARTS/$chart" -n "$ns" --create-namespace --wait "$@"
}

# 1. cert-manager, then its issuer.
helm_install cert-manager cert-manager "cert-manager-{{version.cert-manager}}.tgz" \
  -f "$HERE/cert-manager-values.yaml" || true
for issuer in "$HERE/cert-manager-issuer.yaml" "$HERE/cert-manager-selfsigned.yaml"; do
  [ -f "$issuer" ] && run "${KUBECTL[@]}" apply -f "$issuer"
done

# 2. Metrics Server: the API aggregation HPA and VPA depend on.
helm_install metrics-server kube-system "metrics-server-{{version.metrics-server}}.tgz" || true

# 3. Vertical Pod Autoscaler.
if [ -f "$HERE/vpa-auto-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install vpa vertical-pod-autoscaler "vpa-{{version.vpa}}.tgz" -f "$HERE/vpa-auto-values.yaml" || true
elif [ -f "$HERE/vpa-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install vpa vertical-pod-autoscaler "vpa-{{version.vpa}}.tgz" -f "$HERE/vpa-values.yaml" || true
fi

# 4. Descheduler.
if [ -f "$HERE/descheduler-evict-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install descheduler kube-system "descheduler-{{version.descheduler}}.tgz" \
    -f "$HERE/descheduler-evict-values.yaml" || true
elif [ -f "$HERE/descheduler-dryrun-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install descheduler kube-system "descheduler-{{version.descheduler}}.tgz" \
    -f "$HERE/descheduler-dryrun-values.yaml" || true
fi

# 5. external-dns.
if [ -f "$HERE/external-dns-coredns-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install external-dns external-dns "external-dns-{{version.external-dns}}.tgz" \
    -f "$HERE/external-dns-coredns-values.yaml" || true
elif [ -f "$HERE/external-dns-values.yaml" ]; then
  helm_install external-dns external-dns "external-dns-{{version.external-dns}}.tgz" \
    -f "$HERE/external-dns-values.yaml" || true
fi

# 6. Trivy Operator: needs the vulnerability DB mirrored, never an internet pull.
[ -f "$HERE/trivy-values.yaml" ] && helm_install trivy-operator trivy-system \
  "trivy-operator-{{version.trivy-operator}}.tgz" -f "$HERE/trivy-values.yaml" || true

# 7. OpenTelemetry Collector CR.
[ -f "$HERE/otel-collector.yaml" ] && run "${KUBECTL[@]}" apply -f "$HERE/otel-collector.yaml"

echo "Add-ons applied. Run 50-verify.sh."

exports.name: Acceptance checks
exports.description: Nodes Ready, pods settled, Ceph health, metrics API, cert-manager and Argo CD presence.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Acceptance checks. Read-only. Exits non-zero when anything is not ready.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
KUBECTL=(kubectl)
FAIL=0
ok()  { printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$*"; }
bad() { printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$*"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }

if ! command -v kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  bad "kubectl not installed on the admin host"
  exit 1
fi

if "${KUBECTL[@]}" get nodes >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  total=$("${KUBECTL[@]}" get nodes --no-headers | wc -l)
  ready=$("${KUBECTL[@]}" get nodes --no-headers | awk '$2 == "Ready"' | wc -l)
  [ "$total" -gt 0 ] && [ "$total" = "$ready" ] && ok "$ready/$total nodes Ready" \
    || bad "$ready/$total nodes Ready"
else
  bad "cannot reach the API server (check KUBECONFIG)"
fi

notrun=$("${KUBECTL[@]}" get pods -A --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 != "Running" && $4 != "Completed"' | wc -l)
[ "$notrun" -eq 0 ] && ok "no pods outside Running/Completed" || bad "$notrun pod(s) not Running"

"${KUBECTL[@]}" get apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && ok "metrics API registered" || echo "INFO  metrics API absent (Metrics Server not selected)"

if [ -f "$HERE/cluster-spec.yaml" ]; then
  mon="{{cephMonIp}}"
  health=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -p {{value.sshPort}} "root@$mon" "cephadm shell -- ceph health" 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
  case "$health" in HEALTH_OK*) ok "Ceph $health" ;; *) bad "Ceph health: $health" ;; esac
fi

"${KUBECTL[@]}" -n argocd get application --no-headers >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && ok "Argo CD reachable" || echo "INFO  Argo CD not installed yet"

"${KUBECTL[@]}" get clusterissuer >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && ok "cert-manager CRDs present" || echo "INFO  cert-manager not selected"

echo
echo "verify: $FAIL failure(s)"
[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]

exports.name: cephadm bootstrap script
exports.description: Prepares the engine and bootstraps the first monitor. Engine: {{choice.storage}}.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Engine: {{choice.storage}}   Ceph: {{version.ceph}}
# Roles: MON [{{cephMonNames}}]
#        MGR [{{cephMgrNames}}]
#        OSD [{{cephOsdNames}}]
#        MDS [{{cephMdsNames}}]
#        RGW [{{cephRgwNames}}]
# Runs on the first MON host. deploy.sh copies it there.
set -euo pipefail

MON_IP="{{cephMonIp}}"
ENGINE="{{cephEngine}}"
REGISTRY="{{value.registryHost}}"

# 1. The container engine must exist before cephadm runs. cephadm will not install it.
if [ "$ENGINE" = "docker" ]; then
  dnf install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io || \
    apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io
  systemctl enable --now docker
  mkdir -p /etc/docker
  cat >/etc/docker/daemon.json <<EOF
{ "registry-mirrors": ["https://${REGISTRY}"], "live-restore": true }
EOF
  systemctl restart docker
else
  dnf install -y podman || apt-get install -y podman
  systemctl enable --now podman.socket
fi

# 2. cephadm itself, from the internal repository.
dnf install -y cephadm || apt-get install -y cephadm

# 3. Bootstrap. --docker is passed only for the Docker engine.
cephadm {{cephEngineFlag}} bootstrap \
  --mon-ip "$MON_IP" \
  --cluster-network {{value.storageCidr}} \
  --registry "$REGISTRY" \
  --log-to-file

cephadm shell -- ceph -s
echo "Bootstrap done. Run 20-ceph.sh from the admin host to add the other role hosts."

exports.name: Docker Compose stack for the edge
exports.description: Dataplane and VRRP on the host network.

# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Dataplane: {{choice.edge}}
name: edge

services:
  haproxy:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/haproxy:{{version.haproxy}}
    container_name: edge-haproxy
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./haproxy.cfg:/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/haproxy/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "haproxy", "-c", "-f", "/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  nginx:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/nginx:{{version.nginx}}
    container_name: edge-nginx
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "nginx", "-t"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  keepalived:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/keepalived:{{version.keepalived}}
    container_name: edge-keepalived
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - NET_BROADCAST
      - NET_RAW
      - SYS_MODULE
    volumes:
      - ./keepalived.conf:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf:ro
      - ./keepalived.d:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.d:ro
    pid: host
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

exports.name: Edge node bootstrap script
exports.description: Kernel settings, directories, images and stack start. Run on every edge node.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Edge nodes: {{edgeHostList}}   VIP: {{value.edgeVip}}
set -euo pipefail

REGISTRY="{{value.registryAddr}}"
STACK_DIR=/opt/edge

# 1. Non-local bind, so the dataplane can listen on the VIP before it moves.
cat >/etc/sysctl.d/90-edge.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind = 1
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
EOF
sysctl --system

# 2. Firewall: unicast VRRP, no multicast.
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule protocol value="vrrp" accept' || true
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8404/tcp || true
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8443/tcp || true
firewall-cmd --reload || true

# 3. Runtime from the internal mirror, never from the internet.
dnf install -y docker-ce docker-compose-plugin || \
  apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2
systemctl enable --now docker

# 4. Stack directory and the generated files.
install -d -m 0750 "$STACK_DIR" "$STACK_DIR/certs" "$STACK_DIR/keepalived.d"
# Copy docker-compose.yml, haproxy.cfg, nginx.conf, keepalived.conf and
# keepalived.d/* into $STACK_DIR before starting the stack.

# 5. Start and verify.
cd "$STACK_DIR"
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'edge health: %{http_code}\n' https://{{value.edgeVip}}/healthz || true

exports.name: Kubespray run script
exports.description: Runs the pinned release from its own checkout and virtualenv, offline.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Release: {{choice.kubespray}}   Kubernetes: {{version.kubernetes}}
set -euo pipefail

RELEASE="{{choice.kubespray}}"
BASE=/opt/kubespray
SRC="$BASE/$RELEASE"
INV="$BASE/inventory/{{value.clusterName}}-{{value.env}}"

# One checkout and one virtualenv per release. The Ansible and Python pins differ.
test -d "$SRC" || { echo "missing checkout: $SRC"; exit 1; }
test -d "$INV" || { echo "missing inventory: $INV"; exit 1; }

cd "$SRC"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$BASE/venv-$RELEASE/bin/activate"
ansible --version

ansible-playbook -i "$INV/hosts.ini" cluster.yml \
  -b --become-user=root \
  -e @"$INV/group_vars/all/offline.yml" \
  -e kube_version="{{version.kubernetes}}" \
  "$@"

kubectl --kubeconfig "$INV/artifacts/admin.conf" get nodes -o wide
kubectl --kubeconfig "$INV/artifacts/admin.conf" -n kube-system get pods

exports.name: mTLS and authorization policies
exports.description: STRICT mTLS per namespace, default deny, and the allow rules. Apply deny only after the allows exist.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
# Stage 1: install defaults to permissive. Move one namespace at a time.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
  name: default
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  mtls:
    mode: STRICT
---
# Stage 2: default deny. Apply only after the allow rules below exist.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec: {}
---
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-same-namespace
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  action: ALLOW
  rules:
    - from:
        - source:
            namespaces: ["{{value.appNamespace}}"]
---
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-ingress
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  action: ALLOW
  rules:
    - from:
        - source:
            namespaces: ["istio-ingress"]

exports.name: Gateway API route through the mesh
exports.description: One GatewayClass claim per hostname. Do not put this in front of a hostname another controller serves.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Istio {{version.istio}}   Host: app.{{value.domain}}
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: istio-gateway
  namespace: istio-ingress
spec:
  gatewayClassName: istio
  listeners:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      protocol: HTTPS
      hostname: "app.{{value.domain}}"
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - kind: Secret
            name: app-tls
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: istio-gateway
      namespace: istio-ingress
  hostnames: ["app.{{value.domain}}"]
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /}
      backendRefs:
        - name: app
          port: 8080

exports.name: Directory integration checklist
exports.description: Application-level only. Nodes are never joined to a directory (ADR-0015).
exports.template:
# Directory integration — {{value.clusterName}} ({{value.env}})

Directory: `{{value.directoryHost}}`
Base DN: `{{value.directoryBaseDn}}`
OIDC issuer: `{{value.keycloakHost}}/realms/platform`

**Scope: application layer only.** No SSSD, realmd, Kerberos membership or AD join on any Linux
node. Local break-glass account and offline key are the node recovery path.

## Selected integrations

{{idpTargets}}

## Order of work

1. Confirm the break-glass local account works with the directory unreachable.
2. Create a read-only bind account; store its credential in Vault, never in Git.
3. Configure Keycloak user federation first, `editMode=READ_ONLY`.
4. Create one OIDC client per service, explicit redirect URI, no wildcard.
5. Wire services in order: Argo CD, Rancher, Harbor, GitLab, Vault, Kubernetes API.
6. Remove each service's local superuser path only after a federated admin login works.
7. Alert on failed federated logins, bind failures, and a zero-login drop in working hours.

## Group → role mapping

| Group (DN) | Service | Role |
|---|---|---|
| CN=platform-admins | all | platform administrator |
| CN=platform-operators | Rancher, Argo CD | operator, sync |
| CN=platform-viewers | all | read-only |

Reference: `identity/directory-integration.md`
